entries.title: Psalms 128:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, that walketh in his ways.

entries.title: Psalms 128:2
segments: For thou shalt eat the labour of thy hands; happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

entries.title: Psalms 128:3
segments: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine in the inner part of thy house; thy children like olive-plants round about thy table.

entries.title: Psalms 128:4
segments: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed that feareth Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 128:5
segments: Jehovah will bless thee out of Zion; and mayest thou see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life,

entries.title: Psalms 128:6
segments: And see thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel!
